description: React component for a modal dialog that allows users to copy a link to clipboard, with support for internationalization and accessibility.

classes.name: GetLinkModal
classes.description: A React component that renders a modal dialog for displaying and copying a link.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component state and default props.
